summary: Harden RFC6455 WebSocket handshake/control frames, JSON depth/NaN bounds, and System One contract gates

delivery.outcome: Extract RFC 6455 WebSocket framing into standard/nl_dsl_ws_framing.py and System One schema/formatting helpers into standard/system_one_profiles.py so all modules stay well below 500 lines, while fixing non-ASCII WebSocket handshake crashes, control-frame/RSV/length invariants, JSON NaN/Infinity/depth bounds, and malformed contract/provider handling in select_operation.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to valid WebSocket frames or System One decision envelopes

architecture.decision: Factor RFC 6455 handshake, frame codecs, and strict JSON stream envelopes into standard/nl_dsl_ws_framing.py with re-exports in standard/nl_dsl_llm_ws.py, and factor bounded O_NOFOLLOW schema loading and DSL/URI formatting helpers into standard/system_one_profiles.py while hardening contract gates in standard/system_one_decision.py.

commands: ruff check standard/nl_dsl_ws_framing.py standard/nl_dsl_llm_ws.py standard/system_one_profiles.py standard/system_one_decision.py standard/test_hardening.py
